text: Settle into a position that feels steady
Let your body arrive here
Let your breath find a natural rhythm.
Feel the weight of your body resting downward.
A simple sense of being supported.
Let your shoulders ease, let your jaw relax, feel your attention gathering.
As the space around you becomes quiet, stay with the movement of your breath, the rise
In your chest, the release that follows, a slow organizing in your system.
Allow yourself to settle into this rhythm.
Bring awareness to the space around your eyes, a gentle softening there.
Let that ease move through your face, your jaw, your throat, each area loosening in small
Natural shifts.
Your breath moving through the center of your chest with a little more room.
Now rest your attention at the center of your chest.
Stay with the sensations you find - warmth, movement, stillness, or simple presence.
Let your breath move through the space, a quiet clarity forming inside.
Your inner field adjusts, it becomes more defined.
As you continue breathing, notice a steady point taking shape in your chest, clear and
And calm.
With each breath, a sense of order forming from within.
Let this clarity expand through your chest, your upper back.
This expansion, your awareness becomes spacious, your system aligns around this steady center
Calm balanced present
Stay with this clarity
Feel it strengthen and spread through your breath
Through your attention, through the whole inner space of your body,
This is your renewal, simple, grounded, real.
Take a slow breath in.
Let it move through your entire body
Feel the openness in your chest
The steadiness beneath you, the quiet clarity you've created here
Sit with it for a moment. Let it settle.
When you're ready,
Let your eyes open gently.
Stay connected to this steady center as you move forward.
